a.lede: Nvidia Board reportedly moves to expel Jensen Huang as stock tumbles on latest scandals and lack of succession plans at Nvidia.
a.title: Nvidia’s Board reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang as second extra-marital affair emerges

b.lede: Nvidia gets a new chief executive, days after former CEO Jensen Huang admitted to a romantic affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
b.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang resigns, chipmaker names CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO
